Title: Small World Enamine REAL search
Description: Retrieves close analogues from Enamine REAL, a make-on-demand space of readily synthesisable compounds, through the SmallWorld index. Rather than fingerprint similarity, SmallWorld scores the exact size of the maximum common edge subgraph shared by two structures, a graph-based notion of closeness made tractable by precomputation. The search is bounded at a graph-edit distance of 10 and the hundred best matches are kept. Because REAL molecules are enumerated from reliable reactions and building blocks, retrieved hits are generally orderable rather than hypothetical.
Interpretation: Up to 100 structural analogues of the query molecule retrieved from the Enamine REAL library.
